# Deploying AI Services: Containers, Serving and Monitoring

> Take a trained model from a notebook to a versioned, containerised, monitored service, size it against a latency objective, and release and roll it back on evidence. SDAIA Academy course AE-205, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,406 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Package and serve](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day1.md): From a notebook pickle to a versioned API that checks its inputs and says when it is ready; sessions: From notebook to artefact, A registry for model versions, A prediction API with a contract, Health, readiness and warm-up; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day1.html; about 5,673 tokens
- [Day 2: Containers and a cluster](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day2.md): An image that is small, scanned and configured from outside, running on a local cluster; sessions: Images that are small and reproducible, Scanning and configuration, Running on a local cluster, Serving the embedding model; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day2.html; about 4,898 tokens
- [Day 3: Observe and size](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day3.md): Metrics, logs and traces that answer questions, then the load the service can carry and what it costs; sessions: Metrics that matter, Logs and traces, Load testing, Sizing and cost; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day3.html; about 4,274 tokens
- [Day 4: Release and watch](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day4.md): Release a new version on evidence, roll back a bad one, watch the inputs drift and hand over to the on-call engineer; sessions: Rolling, canary and shadow releases, Rollback on evidence, Drift in replayed traffic, Alerts and a runbook; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/day4.html; about 4,101 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a monitored service and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/capstone.md): Eight minutes to show the service, four minutes of questions, and one fault injected by the assessor; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/slides/capstone.html; about 976 tokens

- [Lab 2.2: Scan, fix, configure](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D2_2_scan_and_config.md): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D2_2_scan_and_config.html
- [Lab 2.3: Deploy to a local cluster](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D2_3_local_cluster.md): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D2_3_local_cluster.html

- [Lab 3.1: Rate, errors and latency](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D3_1_metrics.md): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D3_1_metrics.html
- [Lab 3.2: Logs, redaction and a trace](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D3_2_logs_traces.md): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D3_2_logs_traces.html

- [Lab 3.4: Workers, replicas and cost](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D3_4_sizing_cost.md): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D3_4_sizing_cost.html
- [Lab 4.1: A 10% canary](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D4_1_canary.md): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D4_1_canary.html

- [Lab 4.3: Drift in four weeks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D4_3_drift.md): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D4_3_drift.html
- [Lab 4.4: Two alerts and a runbook](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D4_4_alerts_runbook.md): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-205/labs/D4_4_alerts_runbook.html
